text: EBpay presents itself as a professional multi-currency crypto wallet founded with investment from a world-class blockchain technology team and four major Southeast Asian internet groups, serving over 500,000 merchants; no state entity is named as an owner.

source.name: EBpay website (archived 2024-12-25), site text bundle (_nuxt/22ec48d.js)
source.quote: EBpay钱包是一款专业的多币种钱包，由世界一流区块链技术团队及东南亚四大互联网集团公司投资成立
